backgrounds.name: Disgraced Audit Clerk
backgrounds.description: You once balanced Chancery ledgers before noticing whole regiments of debtors vanished without burial.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Knows Chancery filing codes and spots forged debt-writs quickly.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Clerks and magistrates treat you as a former insider who understands ledger-law.

backgrounds.name: Ash-Quarry Escapee
backgrounds.description: Years hauling pale-iron ore in Cinder-Basin left you scarred, stubborn, and impossible to break.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Endures harsh soot-storms and heavy gear without tiring quickly.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Quarry workers and independent smiths trust your calloused hands on sight.

backgrounds.name: Mist-Weir Ferryhand
backgrounds.description: You poled arrival barges through black fog long enough to memorize every hidden pier and shoal.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Reads river mist, footprints, and dockside ambushes effortlessly.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Oar-Keepers share harbor news and ferry lore freely with a fellow hand.

backgrounds.name: Last-Bell Apprentice
backgrounds.description: Raised among the bronze-founders of Bellwright Square, you hear truth and falsehood like clean or cracked bells.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Starts closer to early Arcane Knowledge milestones through Lore & Medicine.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Bellwrights and scholars recognize your calm cadence and monastic training.

backgrounds.name: Dockside Debt-Skipper
backgrounds.description: You survived the Drowned Piers by staying two alleys ahead of every bailiff and collector.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Always knows a bolted window, loose grate, or fenced purse.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Smugglers and gutter informants talk business without testing your nerve.

backgrounds.name: Lantern-Wall Veteran
backgrounds.description: You held the rusted viaduct until you realized the Chancery was starving your garrison on purpose.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Seasoned against salt-stalkers, ambushes, and frontier deprivations.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Pale Frontier Wardens still salute a veteran of the Rusted Viaduct.
